_comment_client: The one static OAuth client. /register always answers with exactly this,
so claude.ai's connector completes Dynamic Client Registration instead of
falling back to a manual 'enter Client ID' prompt — and no second client
is ever created, no matter how often anyone reconnects.
The secret is OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET, a Coolify env var, never in this file.

services.name: paperlessmcp
_note: strip_path false: PaperlessMCP serves /mcp itself and would 404 on /.
No inject: paperlessmcp already holds PAPERLESS_API_TOKEN, so the
gateway only has to gate access, not supply a credential.
